WorkloadCard is a compact resource card for Kubernetes-style workloads. It shows workload identity, status, replica/age metadata, and CPU/memory/disk utilization backed by the existing time-series primitives: CPU and memory as core-style bars (memory at one bar per GB) and disk as a linear progress bar. Callers own the metric ids; the card only composes the supplied series.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/WorkloadCard.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { WorkloadCard } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/data";
```
